section_summary.extract_value: This section describes a test-retest sample consisting of 109 university students (57 female, 52 male) from Romania. The participants were all of Romanian ethnicity with a mean age of 25.02 years. They completed the BAS-2 at two time points, and no other demographics were collected.
section_summary.evidence_source: The test–retest sample consisted of 57 female and 52 male university students from the same university in the west of Romania. All participants were of Romanian ethnicity and ranged in age from 18 to 57 years (M = 25.02, SD = 8.91). No further demographics were collected, and these participants only completed the BAS-2 at two time-points three weeks apart.
